Adobe Commerce (formerly Magento 2) exposes a REST API at the `/rest/{store-code}/V1/` (or simply `/rest/V1/`) base path for managing products, orders, customers, carts, categories, and other commerce resources. Authentication supports admin and customer integration tokens issued by the API, plus OAuth 1.0a for third-party integrations.
